title: brain backend needs --env for a remote or production database
why: Commands could reach a production database by accident. Without `--env` they stop with B0785 when the database is remote or `NODE_ENV=production`, and a proxied `/_brain/api` request needs an administrator in every environment.
steps: Add `--env production` (or the environment meant) to every `brain backend` command in scripts, pipelines and process files that reach a remote database.
Sign in as an administrator to read `/_brain/api` through the app's origin.
